name: Views insert blocks
description: Inserts blocks into Views output at specific row positions.
project_description:
The Views Insert Block module enables users to seamlessly integrate multiple blocks into specific locations within a View, allowing for enhanced customization and content presentation. Using this module, you can insert blocks for a view at specified positions and on designated pages directly through the View's configuration.

 

 Back to top 

 Configuration 
 To add block, navigate to your view configuration and look for “Add block” under the “Advanced” section and set block configuration options.

 

 

 Back to top 

 Features 
 
 Configure the exact View and choose where the blocks should appear. You can specify the position within the View's content and determine the pages where the blocks will be visible. 
 Add as many blocks as you want. 
 Create the configuration file programmatically with the configured blocks.
